title: Pythagorean Theorem
description: An interactive MicroSim demonstrating the Pythagorean theorem (a² + b² = c²) with adjustable triangle sides and visual proof using squares.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Pythagorean Theorem
learningObjectives: Calculate the hypotenuse c of a right triangle from legs a and b using c² = a² + b²
Explain the visual proof in which the squares built on legs a and b have combined area equal to the square on the hypotenuse
Predict how adjusting side a or side b with the sliders changes the length of the hypotenuse
Identify the legs and hypotenuse of a right triangle and relate their displayed squares to the theorem's equation
